activity.role: Commander-in-Chief of French Armed Forces under CFLN
activity.notes: CFLN decree of 4 Aug 1943 gives Giraud military command subordinated to CFLN defense policy; he was removed on 4 April 1944. His first military responsibilities before the Aug decree and copresidency overlapping through October are independent historically real roles, not duplicate offices.

sources.title: Université de Perpignan, MJP — Décret du 4 août 1943 sur l'organisation du Haut Commandement
sources.citation_text: The 4 August 1943 decree explicitly charges Giraud as Commandant en chef of all French land, sea, air forces, under CFLN's political direction.

sources.title: Fondation Charles de Gaulle — Henri GIRAUD
sources.citation_text: Giraud Third Army 1936, Seventh Army 1939, Ninth Army after 15 May 1940, prisoner on May 18, North Africa civil-military command late 1942, CFLN copresidency 3 June to early Oct 1943, general commander in chief ending 4 April 1944, Superior War Council 1949.

sources.title: Ministère des Armées — Création et action du CFLN
sources.citation_text: CFLN formed 3 June 1943; co-presidency duties eroded by early August and Giraud removed from the Committee 9 November 1943. This committee-membership end differs from earlier de facto political copresidency end.
